capabilities: Publishes notes to XWiki pages with their attachments
Pulls XWiki pages back into the vault as Markdown
Syncs whole XWiki spaces and mirrors folder structure
Converts non-Markdown XWiki pages to Markdown
Shows XWiki inline comments and user mentions in notes
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not publish-only: it also pulls XWiki pages back into the vault and syncs whole spaces in both directions.
extras: Tokens are kept in Obsidian's secret storage and no telemetry is collected. Administrator setup docs (docs/XWIKI_SETUP.md, docs/OPENPROJECT_SETUP.md) are in Turkish. Math and Mermaid publish as text, and converting non-Markdown pages is lossy.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to an XWiki instance or keep XWiki pages synchronized with vault notes as Markdown.

relations.evidence: Publish notes from your vault to XWiki and pull XWiki pages back into your vault as Markdown.
OpenProject 17.6 or later with its XWiki integration.
Use Folder notes settings → Copy to take over its layout, then disable it so folders are not handled twice
relations.plugin: Folder notes plugin by Lost Paul

requires.name: XWiki instance reachable over HTTPS with the Markdown Syntax 1.2 extension
XWiki account with view, edit and delete rights on the relevant spaces
XWiki access token (kept in Obsidian's secret storage)

summary: Two-way sync publishing Obsidian notes to XWiki pages as Markdown and pulling pages back into the vault, with attachments, comments and conflict handling.
